user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign a category to a task successfully
steps: Choose a category from the list
Assign the selected category to the task
positive.expected_result: The task is updated with the selected category.

positive.title: Assign multiple categories to multiple tasks
steps: Select multiple categories for the tasks
Assign the selected categories to the tasks
positive.expected_result: Each task is updated with the selected categories.

negative.title: Assign a non-existent category to a task
steps: Attempt to assign a non-existent category
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the category cannot be found.

negative.title: Assign a category to a task without selecting a task
steps: Attempt to assign a category without selecting any tasks
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that no task has been selected.

edge.title: Assign a category with maximum allowable characters
steps: Create a category with the maximum allowable number of characters
Assign the created category to the task
edge.expected_result: The task is updated with the maximum character category without any issues.

edge.title: Assign a category when network connection is lost
edge.expected_result: The system prompts a network error and prevents the category assignment.
